description: Calm, offline bodyweight training with guided workouts and progressions Kalimory plans your bodyweight training, runs it with you, and remembers every set. There is no account, and nothing goes online: your workouts stay on your phone. Today • This week at a glance, what is due, and a suggestion for what to train next • Start any workout from one button Guided workouts • Rep counting, hold timers and rest timers that keep going with the screen off • Programs of several exercises, which you can pause and resume later • Interval routines with timed work and rest • Log past workouts, with several exercises in one session 157 steps in 29 progression chains • From the wall push-up to the planche, the dead hang to the front lever, and the assisted squat to the pistol squat • Every step has form cues, a muscle map, the equipment it needs, and clear standards to start and to move on • Skills such as the muscle-up and the human flag show the steps they build on • Nothing is locked: train any step whenever you like Progressions • For each chain you follow: your current step, how close you are to moving on, and the dates you started and met each step Progress • Calendar, lists, graphs, personal bests and a weekly goal Your data, your files • Complete JSON backups, CSV import and export, and recovery files if the database is ever damaged Calm by design • Light, dark and true-black AMOLED themes, optional wallpaper colours, and ten languages Privacy • No internet permission, no ads, no analytics and no crash reporting Kalimory began as a fork of Calisthenics Memory by Gonbei774 and is free software under the GPL-3.0.
